description.value: MeiWei Chinese Cuisine is a fully licensed Chinese restaurant on Highway 97 in Kelowna serving a broad menu of traditional Cantonese and Szechuan dishes, group share dinners, and combination plates. The kitchen prides itself on fresh, quality ingredients — their ginger beef uses real red pepper flakes, honey, and freshly ground ginger with no MSG. Online ordering, takeout, delivery, and catering options make it a flexible meal stop for solo cyclists and touring groups alike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms MeiWei Chinese Cuisine is an active, fully licensed Chinese restaurant on Highway 97 in Kelowna, with takeout, delivery, and catering explicitly stated on the About page. The About page also confirms vegetarian/vegan options and gluten-friendly dishes. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving those fields unresolvable from available evidence.
